8.steps:

2- Go to Firewall/Service page

3- Modify custom services and custom service groups being used in the NAT policy

4- Go to Network/NAT Policy page

5- Click on Custom Policies and IPv6 Only radio buttons

6- Verify that custom services and custom service groups in the NAT Policies are updated in NAT Policy table

23.steps:
1- Login to management interface through a web browser
2- Go to Network/Address Object page
3- Click IPv6 Only radio Button and add the following address Groups:
IPv6-LAN-Group with LAN IPs 2001::115, 2001::116, 2001::117, 2001::118, 2001::119 & 2001::120
IPv6-WAN-Group with less number of WAN IPs 2001:1::200 and 2001:1::201
4- Go to Network/NAT Policy page
5- Click IPv6 Only radio Button
6- Add the following NAT policy:
Source Destination Service Interface OriginalTranslatedOriginalTranslatedOriginalTranslatedInboundOutbound
AnyOriginalIPv6-WAN-GroupIPv6-LAN-Group AnyOriginal X1Any (All Unmapped ) (few to many )(All Unmapped)
7- Create necessary access rules
8- Verify that NAT Policy works

note: When to configure a DNAT policy, user shall firstly add original destination IP addresses to the interface, as an IPv6 interface support multiple addressing.
like: IPv6-WAN-Group 2001:470:80b7:869::36-39/128. must add them IPS to  WAN interface on  Advanced page

44.steps:
1- Login to management interface through a web browser

2- Go to Network/NAT Policy page

3- Click IPv6 Only radio Button

4- Create several IPv6 NAT Policies from WAN to LAN, WAN to DMZ, DMZ to WAN etc..

5- Export Prefs

6- Reboot the box to factory default settings

7- Import Prefs back and verify that IPv6 NAT policies remain intact
